name: TextInput

props.name: decorator
props.description: **Experimental**: Provide a `decorator` component to be rendered inside the `TextInput` component

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Optionally provide the default value of the `<input>`

props.name: disabled
props.description: Specify whether the `<input>` should be disabled

props.name: enableCounter
props.description: Specify whether to display the character counter

props.name: helperText
props.description: Provide text that is used alongside the control label for additional help

props.name: hideLabel
props.description: Specify whether you want the underlying label to be visually hidden

props.name: inline
props.description: `true` to use the inline version.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Specify whether the control is currently invalid

props.name: invalidText
props.description: Provide the text that is displayed when the control is in an invalid state

props.name: labelText
props.description: Provide the text that will be read by a screen reader when visiting this control

props.name: light
props.description: `true` to use the light version. For use on $ui-01 backgrounds only. Don't use this to make tile background color same as container background color. 'The `light` prop for `TextInput` has ' + 'been deprecated in favor of the new `Layer` component. It will be removed in the next major release.'

props.name: maxCount
props.description: Max character count allowed for the input. This is needed in order for enableCounter to display

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Specify the placeholder attribute for the `<input>`

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Whether the input should be read-only

props.name: size
props.description: Specify the size of the Text Input. Currently supports the following:

props.name: slug
props.description: **Experimental**: Provide a `Slug` component to be rendered inside the `TextInput` component

props.name: type
props.description: Specify the type of the `<input>`

props.name: value
props.description: Specify the value of the `<input>`

props.name: warn
props.description: Specify whether the control is currently in warning state

props.name: warnText
props.description: Provide the text that is displayed when the control is in warning state

a11y.note: Carbon ships a11y behaviour per component; verify per screen

when_to_use: Use Carbon TextInput rather than building one.
when_not_to_use: Do not restyle off-token — propose a token instead.
